Turns insights into campaigns in one prompt
 
 
 
 Get a Demo
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Trusted by 2,000+ brands across Europe
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Every customer journey, powered from one platform
 
 
 
Every visit, click, cart, and purchase tells a story. Your team gets one place to read that story clearly, 
decide what should happen next, and build journeys customers actually want to follow.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Customer Data Platform
 
 
 
Give your team a single live view of every customer.
Behaviour, purchases, engagement, preferences, consent, and predictive signals come together in a single profile that is ready to use in campaigns, journeys, and personalisation.
Understand who to engage, what to say and when to act, all from one place.
 
 
 
See more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Marketing Automation
 
 
 
Build journeys around real customer behaviour, not static campaign calendars.
Trigger the right message when customers browse, buy, abandon, return or disengage.
From simple follow-ups to sophisticated cross-channel journeys, every campaign adapts automatically as customers move
 
 
 
See more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Commerce Marketing
 
 
 
Capture intent from views, carts, wishlists, back-in-stock requests, price-drop alerts, and purchase history to act when the customer is most likely to convert.
Keep every commerce journey connected to what customers are showing you, so your team can recover missed revenue and create the next buying moment faster.
 
 
 
See more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Personalisation
 
 
 
Personalisation works best when it feels useful, not forced.
Use customer data, behaviour, AI predictions, and product context to adapt messages, offers, timing and experiences to each customer automatically.
Keep every touchpoint relevant by matching what each customer sees to their interests, intent, purchase history, and stage in the journey.
 
 
 
See more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Recommendations
 
 
 
Recommend products based on what each customer is likely to want next, not just on what is currently popular.
Use browsing history, purchase behaviour, product data, and AI scoring to make recommendations more relevant throughout the journey.
 
 
 
See more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
AI that actually works for your team
This is not AI in a hidden tab. It works across data, workflows, content, recommendations, and reports, helping your team turn ideas into campaigns faster.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Power of AI
 
 
 
Make use of predictive, generative, conversational, recommendation, and agentic AI in one marketing workflow. Powered by your customer data, it can score customers, draft content, build audiences, recommend products, analyse performance, and help prepare campaigns from a simple brief.
 
 
 
See more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Agentic AI
 
 
 
Give AI a goal with a simple prompt. Watch it help create the audience, draft the content, build the workflow, suggest the timing, and prepare the campaign for approval. Your team stays in control of strategy and final decisions, while AI handles the operational work between idea and launch.
 
 
 
See more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
AI MCP
 
 
 
Manago AI meets your team where they already think and work. Access customer data, create campaigns and take action directly from ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and other MCP-compatible tools. The distance between an idea and a live campaign disappears
 
 
 
See more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Every channel your customers use.
One platform to reach them all.
 
 
 
Build one connected journey across email, SMS, WhatsApp, push, and web. Use AI to optimise which channel reaches each customer best.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Email
 
 
 
 
Create emails that are built on what customers actually do, not just who they are in your database. 
Use live customer data, product context, and AI-assisted content to build newsletters, life cycle campaigns, and automated flows that feel timely, personal, and worth opening.
 
 
 
 
See more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
SMS
 
 
 
 
Use SMS for moments that need speed, clarity, and attention. 
Send personalised messages through a built-in SMS gateway, connect them to your customer journeys, and support two-way conversations when a simple message should become an interaction.
 
 
 
 
See more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
WhatsApp
 
 
 
 
Bring WhatsApp into your customer journeys instead of treating it as a separate communication tool. 
Send template messages, manage session conversations, and add rich media to make customer communication more useful, visual, and direct.
 
 
 
 
See more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Website Engagement
 
 
 
 
Turn your website into a journey that adapts to each visitor. 
Use real-time behaviour and customer data to show the right prompt, product, offer, or proof point, helping more anonymous visitors subscribe, more browsers convert, and more customers come back to buy again.
 
 
 
 
See more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Connect the systems you already use
Connect your existing systems to Manago AI with ready-made integrations for speed and APIs, custom data flows, and MCP when your setup needs more flexibility.

Manago AI is a Customer Engagement Platform trusted by 2,000+ businesses. It helps marketers connect their data, understand every customer, communicate across every channel and drive results through a simpler, prompt-driven experience powered by agentic AI.
